page_description: Bring saved Wallabag articles to your Kobo, then archive or favorite them as you read.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Wallabag instance and a bearer credential accepted by its API.
Install that credential under the exact name wallabag.

user: Somebody who saves articles to read properly later.
job: Read your Wallabag articles on e-ink, anywhere.
offline: Articles already fetched work without the network; fetching new ones does not.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the originals stay in your Wallabag

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to fetch articles from your Wallabag

non_goals: It does not archive or delete in Wallabag.
It does not clip pages itself.
